snippet.title: [Touhou Fan Game] Marisa! Return the Book! Promotion PV!
snippet.description:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Ren7z1EZQ/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=cd6f5359f0a21add688647afbd51e72e

If you find it interesting, please add it to your wishlist to support us~
Steam Store Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737620/_/

------------Game Introduction--------------

Gensokyo is in an uproar!! That little girl with yellow hair and black-and-white clothes is out borrowing books everywhere again. Alice can no longer tolerate Marisa's "book-borrowing" behavior and has called on everyone in Gensokyo to launch a crusade against Marisa!

The game falls under the idle/afk genre and features an overall lighthearted and joyful style. It is set to participate in the October Steam Next Fest for a demo trial.

Developed by two creators, @Narrow-- and @Tsukuyomi C, this Touhou Project fan game aims to bring players a fun and enjoyable gaming experience~

Finally, if you're interested, we hope you can add it to your wishlist as encouragement and support for us.

2025/10/3
Suddenly so many people are checking this out! Thank you all for your love and support! We’ve still been busy optimizing the values and adding new characters lately. Since there are only two people in the team, we might rarely have time to read the comments. If you find it interesting, feel free to add it to your wishlist~ Thank you all for your support! We’re off to keep working hard now!
（Sorry my English isn’t great, but thanks so much for your support!!!）
2025/10/14
Hello everyone, Steam now supports normal downloads of the demo. Clicking on the house deals 1 damage, and the effect of Aya Shameimaru's skill on the house needs to be triggered by a click! Thank you all!                                        -------------------------------------------Please make sure to complete the tutorial until the first retreat; otherwise, it may affect your save data. The demo content is limited. As the official release is approaching, we will launch the full version around the end of November, which will include a large number of characters, additional event gameplay, and easter eggs. Thank you for your understanding.
